injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Devin Carter

injuries.name: Moussa Diabate

injuries.comment: Boswell is rehabbing a right knee injury, and he's hopeful to be cleared for basketball activities prior to the start of the G League season in late October.

injuries.name: Tobe Awaka

injuries.name: Sam Merrill

injuries.name: Santi Aldama

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis

injuries.name: Jarace Walker

injuries.name: Aaron Nesmith
injuries.comment: Nesmith (hamstring) will not play in Friday's preseason finale against Milwaukee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy

injuries.name: Bradley Beal

injuries.name: Max Strus
injuries.comment: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
injuries.comment: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Brandon Ingram
injuries.comment: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller

injuries.name: Jarred Vanderbilt

injuries.name: Cameron Carr

injuries.name: Adou Thiero

injuries.name: Dejounte Murray

injuries.name: Cason Wallace

injuries.name: Anthony Black

injuries.name: Anfernee Simons

injuries.name: Luke Kennard

injuries.name: Chris Youngblood

injuries.name: Micah Potter

injuries.name: Jrue Holiday

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe

injuries.name: Malik Monk

injuries.name: Dylan Cardwell
injuries.comment: Cardwell (calf) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, with a longer absence possible, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.comment: Raynaud (knee) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, and potentially longer, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.comment: Bittle (foot) agreed to a two-way contract with Toronto on Saturday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Blake Hinson
injuries.comment: Hinson (hamstring) is listed as out for Friday's preseason game against Phoenix.

injuries.name: Trey Alexander
injuries.comment: Alexander is out for Friday's preseason finale in Phoenix due to a left knee injury.

injuries.name: Kyle Filipowski
injuries.comment: Jazz head coach Will Hardy said Saturday that Filipowski is progressing well and doing the necessary steps to get back on the court, but the big man doesn't have a return timeline, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.comment: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

injuries.name: AJ Dybantsa
injuries.comment: Dybantsa (ankle) won't return to Friday's preseason game against the Pelicans, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports. He'll finish with 12 points (4-8 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 3-4 FT), two rebounds and one block in 15 minutes.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
